test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

My mother said to me, "Don't tell a lie".

options.text: My mother forbade me from telling a lie.
My mother forbade me not to tell a lie.
My mother said me to told not a lie
My mother said me to tell not a lie.

solution:
The reported speech is '**My mother forbade me from telling a lie.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **Direct Speech** and we have to change it into **Reported speech**.
 
• The **process of transformation** is as follows:
 
 
• The reporting verb "**said to**" will be removed.
 
• The **conjunction** "**from**" will be added and **inverted commas** will be removed.
 
• The sentence "**Don't tell a lie**" will be changed to a command with the **verb** "**forbade from telling**" in **reported speech**.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct option is:
 
 
• **My mother forbade me from telling a lie**.
 
 

Thus, ***option 1*** is the correct answer.
